name: Kim Min-seo
bio:
Kim Min-seo's meticulous nature and passion for precision led her to motorsport after graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering from KAIST. Initially, she worked with a small engine manufacturer, but the draw of the track proved too strong. She joined Tolman Motorsport five years ago, quickly establishing herself as a vital part of the quality control team. Her approach centers on rigorous testing and data analysis to identify potential weaknesses before they impact performance. 

Min-seo is known for her unwavering focus and ability to spot minute discrepancies that others might miss. She thrives under pressure and is dedicated to upholding the highest standards of quality. What sets Min-seo apart is her knack for adapting established protocols to suit the unique demands of each race, ensuring consistency and reliability on every circuit.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers
physical.description: Kim has a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
